test: frozen M10 two matches; no new tuning
tracklets: 8–12 frames from10–70s and170–250s, same frames for every model; original M10 crop/10–30-frame windows additionally for image models
geometry_ablation: .8 cosine+.2 exp(-pitch_distance/(12*elapsed+3)); fixed supplied-calibration proxy, not certified geometry
scorer_training: all chronological40s windows with positive elapsed<=130s; no ID/absolute-coordinate inputs
scorer_selection: L2 logistic C1, fixed model; probability threshold on same-team VALIDATION only at empirical FMR<=.01
primary_beat: temporal vs M10 matched tracklets: same-team Rank1 and mAP both >=+0.03
shadow: all three sources; physical constraints/epochs/teams/global one-to-one assignment and ambiguity margin retained; probability only replaces appearance evidence in scorer variant
integration: requires successful heldout gate and reliable independently verified player-decision gains; no automatic activation from retrieval
